verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. `--limit` now uses an argparse type that rejects negative values, defines `None` as the sole unlimited sentinel, gives `--limit 0` zero-write semantics, and defensively clamps direct helper calls. The shared budget still caps additions plus removals, and focused self-tests cover negative, zero, positive, absent, and mixed-plan cases. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect in the diff.
